retained_findings: UniProf's strongest transferable value is its cross-runtime profiler plugin/normalization layer and common hotspot-analysis contract, not a new state or effect authority.

ProfileContext/ProfileAnalysis preserve useful profiler/artifact/sampling/profile-type dimensions but lack F2 causal identity, immutable image/profiler/target/artifact digests and explicit coverage/confidence semantics.
Container images are selected with mutable :latest tags; exact-source runtime evidence therefore requires digest pinning or exact-source rebuild before any E3 credit.

Linux perf requests SYS_ADMIN+SYS_PTRACE and the generic runner maps SYS_ADMIN to --privileged; Python container profiling requests SYS_PTRACE. These privileges are not suitable as implicit/default F2 authority.
Container profiling mounts the working directory read-write and can optionally use host networking; profiling still executes the target and is not intrinsically read-only observation.

The MCP run_profiler surface accepts command+cwd and executes the profiling target, so direct model-side adoption would create an execution-capable path. F2 must keep EffectGate/authorized execution authority outside UniProf.
Several profilers default near 999 Hz and evented profiles are normalized into synthetic weighted samples. Observer overhead and cross-profiler semantic equivalence must be measured, not assumed.
Repository code is MIT, while bundled profiler images contain third-party components under separate licenses.

architecture_recommendation.preferred_contract: ProfileObservationEnvelope as noncanonical measurement input to F2 telemetry, with exact target/observer/profiler/image/artifact identity, privilege scope, sampling/profile type, coverage/symbol quality, analysis parameters and observer-overhead fields.

next_discriminator.summary: Use a deterministic local Python hotspot+child fixture on an admitted zero-cost isolated Linux surface; pin exact UniProf/py-spy/image identities, forbid SYS_ADMIN/--privileged, compare unprofiled vs lower-rate vs 999 Hz profiling, and measure diagnostic accuracy, child coverage, run-to-run variance, wall/CPU/RSS overhead, artifact cost, symbol coverage, path/secret exposure and behavior when SYS_PTRACE is unavailable.

database_materialization.reason: No direct binary DB rewrite was attempted through the source connector. This mirror is provenance/indexing only and cannot replace the F2 canonical result or pending_research.sqlite.
